statement: Let n ≥ 1 be polynomially bounded and polynomial-time computable, and let ℓ ≥ 2 be a short polynomial-time computable integer. Suppose that r1, . . . , rn, v are controlled integer polynomial families in variables x = (x1, . . . , xn) and a polynomially bounded number of parameter variables t, uniformly in i, and that degx ri < ℓ. In the monomial basis of Z[t, x]/(xℓ 1 − r1, . . . , xℓ n − rn), 14 let Mv denote multiplication by v. Then Q(t, y) = det(yI − Mv) (3.16) is a controlled family, monic of y-degree D = ℓn. If d and 2b are common total-degree and coefficient-norm bounds on the ri, v, and T = d + n(ℓ − 1), valid total-degree and log-norm bounds on Q are dQ = D 1 + d(1 + T)  , bQ = D2 + D 1 + b(1 + T)  . (3.17) The construction is compatible with specializing any parameters.
